item.title: Tesco moving 40k server workloads off VMware amid Broadcom's abusive conduct
item.description:
📝 Tesco, which reported 73. In January, Broadcom stopped supporting Tesco’s VMware products, Tesco said, and Tesco has been paying for third-party support since. In its recent filings, Tesco said it turned down at least four offers from Broadcom to continue using VMware and Broadcom’s mainframe tech.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/information-technology/2026/06/tesco-moving-40000-server-workloads-off-vmware-amid-broadcoms-abusive-conduct/
